title: Playing by head and ragtime tunes
summary: Parker discusses bands playing by head, ragtime, made-up tunes like Funky Butt, and who made up tunes best.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days
